HomeHero.afternoonTitle: Motshegare o o monate! Dinako tsa Bibela tsa letsatsi la gago.

HomeHero.eveningTitle: Maitseboa a a monate! Ikhutse ka dinako tsa Bibela.

HomeHero.joinUsTitle: Batho ba dibilione ba a batla

Mission.eyebrow: E diretswe thomo ya lefatshe lotlhe
Mission.headline: Molaetsa ga o fetoge. Tsela e batho ba bogelang ka yone e a fetoga.
Mission.intro: Re aga sešwa laeborari ya rona ya dibidio le didiriswa go tloga kwa tshimologong, re isa tiro ya dingwaga di le dintsi ya thanolo kwa dipolatefomong tse batho ba setseng ba kopana, ba bogela le go abelana mo go tsone.
Mission.libraryPointTitle: Laeborari ya difilimi e e ranotsweng go gaisa mo lefatsheng
Mission.libraryPointDescription: Tiro ya thanolo ya dingwaga di le dintsi, e e dirilweng ke balekane ba bodiredi ba ba ikanyegang, e agile laeborari e e nang le dikgatiso tsa dipuo di le diketekete, gore batho ba kopane le polelo ya ga Jesu ka puo e e ba amang thata mo pelong.
Mission.formatsPointTitle: Go isa mantswe a a ikanyegang kwa dipopegong tse dintšhwa
Mission.formatsPointDescription: Re aga sešwa tsela e dipolelo tsa Efangele di bolelwang ka yone ka ditshwantsho, re kopanya dithanolo tse di ikanyegang le dipopego tsa segompieno gore molaetsa o kgone go tsamaya ka kgololesego mo dipolatefomong, mo ditsong le mo disekirining.
Mission.teamPointTitle: Go feta laeborari. Setlhopha se se tsamaisiwang ke thomo.
Mission.teamPointDescription: Jesus Film Project ke setlhopha sa lefatshe lotlhe sa baranodi, baitseanape ba media, batlhophi le babopi ba ba fetolang maitemogelo a dingwaga di le dintsi a bodiredi go nna didiriswa tsa ba ba dirang barutwa gongwe le gongwe.
Mission.highlightsHeading: Se re se agang go latela
Mission.nextStepsTitle: Polatefomo ya Dikgato tse di Latelang
Mission.nextStepsDescription: E golaganya babogedi le ditšhono tse di bonalang mo loetong lwa bone lwa semowa, e ba thusa go tsaya kgato e e latelang go ya kwa setšhabeng, kwa Dikwalong kgotsa kwa thomong.
Mission.mediaLibraryDescription: Laeborari e kgolo ya media ya Sekeresete e e nang le dibidio, difilimi le metswedi di le diketekete, e e leng teng ka dipuo di le dintsi go direla bodiredi le go anamisa Efangele lefatshe lotlhe.
Mission.ministryToolsDescription: Taolo ya dibidio, kabo ya diteng, go amana le babogedi le tshekatsheko ya dipalo, tse di diretsweng go thusa bodiredi go fitlhelela batho ba bantsi ka katlego.
Mission.inviteHeadline: Thusa go aga {accent} ya didiriswa tsa thomo
Mission.inviteBody: Re laletsa badiri, babopi le balekane go simolola go dirisa pele. Leka didiriswa tse dintšhwa pele, o neele maikutlo, mme o thuse go bopa ditsweletswa tse di diretsweng tiro ya mmatota ya thomo.
Mission.missionCardAriaHint: E bula tsebe ya thomo ya Jesus Film
Mission.roadmapCardAriaHint: E bula tsebe ya thomo ya Jesus Film kwa setlhopheng sa togamaano
Mission.betaCardAriaHint: E bula go ikwadisa ga beta mo sebatling sa gago

Feedback.title: Romela maikutlo
Feedback.pickKindHeading: O batla go re bolelela eng?
Feedback.successMessage: Re a leboga. Re amogetse maikutlo a gago.
Feedback.failureMessage: Ga re a kgona go a romela. Leka gape morago ga metsotso e le mmalwa.
Feedback.messagePlaceholder: Re bolelele se o se lemogileng.
Feedback.translationMessagePlaceholder: Ke mokwalo ofe o o fosagetseng, mme o mo sekirining sefe? Tsenya thanolo e e botoka fa o e itse.
Feedback.translationLanguageNotice: Re romela le puo ya app, gore re itse gore re baakanye thanolo efe.
